+                [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ten, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
+        guard case .ambiguous(source: .waste, cardIndex: 0, let destinations) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected ambiguous move with multiple legal destinations.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(Set(destinations), Set([.tableau(0), .tableau(1)]))
+        XCTAssertEqual(source, PileID.waste)
+    }
+
+    func testBlockedMoveWhenNoDestinations() {
+        let state = GameState(
+            stock: [],
+            waste: [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)],
+            foundations: [
+                .clubs: [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)],
+                .diamonds: [],
+                .hearts: [],
+                .spades: [],
+            ],
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
+        guard case .blocked(let reason) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected blocked move when no legal destination exists.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertFalse(reason.isEmpty)
+    }
+
+    func testRunRelocationValidationForTableauMove() {
+        var state = GameState(
+            stock: [],
+            waste: [],
+            foundations: [
+                .clubs: [],
+                .diamonds: [],
+                .hearts: [],
+                .spades: [],
+            ],
+            tableau: [
+                [
+                    Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .queen),
+                    Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .jack, isFaceUp: true),
+                    Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ten, isFaceUp: true),
+                    Card(suit: .spades, rank: .nine, isFaceUp: true),
+                ],
+                [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+        state.tableau[0][1].isFaceUp = true
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(
+            in: state,
+            source: .tableau(0),
+            sourceIndex: 1,
+            destination: .tableau(1)
+        )
+
+        guard case .executed(let move) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected multi-card run to execute.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.source, .tableau(0))
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.destination, .tableau(1))
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.cards.map(\.id), [

@@ -0,0 +1,176 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

+            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsMissingRankInAValidSuit() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        state.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        state.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == illegalTop.suit && $0.rank == illegalTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == illegalBase.suit && $0.rank == illegalBase.rank)
+        }
+        state.foundations[.spades] = [
+            illegalBase,
+            illegalTop,
+        ]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+
+    private func validStateTemplate() -> GameState {
+        let ordered = DeckFactory.orderedCards()
+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
+
+        return GameState(
+            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
+            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
+            foundations: foundations,
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+    }
+
+    private func removeFirstHeart(state: GameState) -> GameState {
+        var altered = state
+        altered.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        altered.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true))
+        return altered
+    }
+
+    private func baseCardSwapBase() -> GameState { validStateTemplate() }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,176 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,176 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}

+                .clubs: [],
+                .diamonds: [],
+                .hearts: [],
+                .spades: [],
+            ],
+            tableau: [
+                [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne

+
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)

+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],

+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
+        guard case .ambiguous(source: .waste, cardIndex: 0, let destinations) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected ambiguous move with multiple legal destinations.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(Set(destinations), Set([.tableau(0), .tableau(1)]))
+        XCTAssertEqual(source, PileID.waste)
+    }

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class RestoreIntegrityServiceTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testRejectsDuplicateCard() {
+        let base = validStateTemplate()
+        var mutated = base
+        mutated.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(mutated)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsMissingRankInAValidSuit() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        state.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        state.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == illegalTop.suit && $0.rank == illegalTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == illegalBase.suit && $0.rank == illegalBase.rank)
+        }
+        state.foundations[.spades] = [
+            illegalBase,
+            illegalTop,
+        ]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+
+    private func validStateTemplate() -> GameState {
+        let ordered = DeckFactory.orderedCards()
+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
+
+        return GameState(
+            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
+            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
+            foundations: foundations,
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+    }
+
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..6c3803aef98e03b92c0cf96ae7b4c2c6e3e42918
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Domain/Rules/MoveValidator.swift
@@ -0,0 +1,176 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}

+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
+        guard case .ambiguous(source: .waste, cardIndex: 0, let destinations) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected ambiguous move with multiple legal destinations.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(Set(destinations), Set([.tableau(0), .tableau(1)]))
+        XCTAssertEqual(source, PileID.waste)
+    }

+                    Card(suit: .spades, rank: .nine, isFaceUp: true),
+                ],
+                [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+        state.tableau[0][1].isFaceUp = true
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(

+
+        guard case .executed(let move) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected multi-card run to execute.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.source, .tableau(0))

+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex).contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}

+                [],
+                [],
+                [],

+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)

+            return XCTFail("Expected ambiguous move with multiple legal destinations.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(Set(destinations), Set([.tableau(0), .tableau(1)]))
+        XCTAssertEqual(source, PileID.waste)

+import XCTest
+

+

+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(mutated)

+

+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)

+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)

+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+

+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
