@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

public enum MoveValidator {
    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        switch destinations.count {
        case 0:
            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
        case 1:
            return .executed(Move(
                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
                source: source,
                destination: destinations[0]
            ))
        default:
            return .ambiguous(
                source: source,
                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
                destinations: destinations
            )
        }
    }

    public static func attempt(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> MoveOutcome {
        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let cards else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
        }

        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
    }

    public static func legalDestinations(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [PileID] {
        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard let movingCards else { return [] }

        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
        var destinations: [PileID] = []

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
                destinations.append(foundation)
            }
        }

        for index in state.tableau.indices {
            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
            if tableau == source { continue }

            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
                destinations.append(tableau)
            }
        }

        return destinations
    }

    public static func movingCards(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
    ) -> [Card]? {
        switch source {
        case .stock:
            return nil
        case .waste:
            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
            return [top]
        case .foundation:
            return nil
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard let sourceIndex else {
                return nil
            }
            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
        }
    }

    public static func isLegal(
        cards: [Card],
        source: PileID,
        destination: PileID,
        state: GameState
    ) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
        let head = cards[0]

        switch destination {
        case .stock, .waste:
            return false
        case .foundation(let suit):
            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
            if destination == source { return false }
            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
        }
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
        guard let destinationTop else {
            return card.rank == .king
        }
        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
    }

    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
        if let top = destination.last {
            return top.isFaceUp &&
            top.suit == card.suit &&
            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
        }
        return card.rank == .ace
    }

    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
        switch pile {
        case .stock:
            return state.stock.last
        case .waste:
            return state.waste.last
        case .foundation(let suit):
            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
        case .tableau(let index):
            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
            return state.tableau[index].last
        }
    }

    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?
    ) -> String {
        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
            return "No legal move source selected."
        }
        return "No legal destination for selected card."
    }

    private static func moveBlockedReason(
        in state: GameState,
        source: PileID,
        sourceIndex: Int?,
        destination: PileID
    ) -> String {
        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
            return "Invalid source for move."
        }
        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
            return "No cards selected."
        }
        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
            return "Destination is not legal."
        }
        return "Move blocked."
    }
}

public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
    private enum Constants {
        static let maxDepth = 200
    }

    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]

    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
        self.entries = entries
    }

    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
        entries.append(snapshot)
        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
        }
    }

    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
        return entries.popLast()
    }

    public var isEmpty: Bool {
        entries.isEmpty
    }
}

public enum RunRelocation {
    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
        from state: GameState,
        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
        head cardIndex: Int
    ) -> [Card]? {
        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
            return nil
        }

        let head = pile[cardIndex]
        guard head.isFaceUp else {
            return nil
        }

        var run = [head]
        var cursor = cardIndex

        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
            guard next.isFaceUp else {
                break
            }

            let moving = run.last!
            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
                break
            }
            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
                break
            }

            run.append(next)
            cursor += 1
        }

        return run
    }
}

/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
/// silently activated as a resumed game.
public struct RestoreIntegrityService {
    public init() {}

    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
            return allCardsResult
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
            }
        }

        for tableau in state.tableau {
            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
        for cards in state.tableau {
            allCards += cards
        }
        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
        }

        if allCards.count != 52 {
            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
        }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]

        for card in allCards {
            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
            }
            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
        }

        for suit in Suit.allCases {
            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
            if ranks.count != 13 {
                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
            }
            for rank in Rank.allCases {
                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
                }
            }
        }

        return .valid
    }

    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }

        var hasFaceUpSegment = false

        for index in 0..<cards.count {
            let current = cards[index]

            if current.isFaceUp {
                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
                    continue
                }

                let previous = cards[index - 1]
                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }

                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
                    return false
                }
                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
                    return false
                }
            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }
}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
+            return "No cards selected."
+        }
+        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class MoveValidatorTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testSingleDestinationAutoExecutesMove() {
+        var state = GameState(
+            stock: [],
+            waste: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: true)],
+            foundations: [
+                .clubs: [],
+                .diamonds: [],
+                .hearts: [],
+                .spades: [],
+            ],
+            tableau: [
+                [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .king, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
+        guard case .executed(let move) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected auto-executed move with exactly one legal destination.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.source, .waste)
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.destination, .foundation(.hearts))
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.cards.count, 1)
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.cards.first, Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: true))
+    }
+
+    func testAmbiguousMoveReturnsDestinations() {
+        let movingCard = Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .nine, isFaceUp: true)
+        let state = GameState(
+            stock: [],
+            waste: [movingCard],
+            foundations: [
+                .clubs: [],
+                .diamonds: [],
+                .hearts: [Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: true)],
+                .spades: [],
+            ],
+            tableau: [
+                [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .ten, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ten, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
+        guard case .ambiguous(source: .waste, cardIndex: 0, let destinations) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected ambiguous move with multiple legal destinations.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(Set(destinations), Set([.tableau(0), .tableau(1)]))
+        XCTAssertEqual(source, PileID.waste)
+    }
+
+    func testBlockedMoveWhenNoDestinations() {
+        let state = GameState(
+            stock: [],
+            waste: [Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)],
+            foundations: [
+                .clubs: [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)],
+                .diamonds: [],
+                .hearts: [],
+                .spades: [],
+            ],
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)
+        guard case .blocked(let reason) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected blocked move when no legal destination exists.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertFalse(reason.isEmpty)
+    }
+
+    func testRunRelocationValidationForTableauMove() {
+        var state = GameState(
+            stock: [],
+            waste: [],
+            foundations: [
+                .clubs: [],
+                .diamonds: [],
+                .hearts: [],
+                .spades: [],
+            ],
+            tableau: [
+                [
+                    Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .queen),
+                    Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .jack, isFaceUp: true),
+                    Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ten, isFaceUp: true),
+                    Card(suit: .spades, rank: .nine, isFaceUp: true),
+                ],
+                [Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .queen, isFaceUp: true)],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+                [],
+            ],
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+        state.tableau[0][1].isFaceUp = true
+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(
+            in: state,
+            source: .tableau(0),
+            sourceIndex: 1,
+            destination: .tableau(1)
+        )
+
+        guard case .executed(let move) = outcome else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected multi-card run to execute.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.source, .tableau(0))
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.destination, .tableau(1))
+        XCTAssertEqual(move.cards.map(\.id), [

+            Card(suit: .hearts, rank: .ten, isFaceUp: true).id,

+    }

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class RestoreIntegrityServiceTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testRejectsDuplicateCard() {
+        let base = validStateTemplate()
+        var mutated = base
+        let duplicateCard = mutated.waste.removeLast()
+        _ = mutated.stock.removeFirst()
+        mutated.stock.append(duplicateCard)
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(mutated)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsMissingRankInAValidSuit() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        state.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        state.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == illegalTop.suit && $0.rank == illegalTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == illegalBase.suit && $0.rank == illegalBase.rank)
+        }
+        state.foundations[.spades] = [
+            illegalBase,
+            illegalTop,
+        ]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+
+    private func validStateTemplate() -> GameState {
+        let ordered = DeckFactory.orderedCards()
+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
+
+        return GameState(
+            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
+            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
+            foundations: foundations,
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+    }
+

@@ -0,0 +1,179 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
+            return "No cards selected."
+        }
+        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

+        let outcome = MoveValidator.attempt(in: state, source: .waste, sourceIndex: nil)

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class RestoreIntegrityServiceTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testRejectsDuplicateCard() {
+        let base = validStateTemplate()
+        var mutated = base
+        let duplicateCard = mutated.waste.removeLast()
+        _ = mutated.stock.removeFirst()
+        mutated.stock.append(duplicateCard)
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(mutated)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsMissingRankInAValidSuit() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        state.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        state.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == illegalTop.suit && $0.rank == illegalTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == illegalBase.suit && $0.rank == illegalBase.rank)
+        }
+        state.foundations[.spades] = [
+            illegalBase,
+            illegalTop,
+        ]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+
+    private func validStateTemplate() -> GameState {
+        let ordered = DeckFactory.orderedCards()
+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
+
+        return GameState(
+            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
+            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
+            foundations: foundations,
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+    }
+
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..ae02978e962586bbab5b8901eb444e21b7c058a2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Domain/Rules/MoveValidator.swift
@@ -0,0 +1,179 @@
+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
+            return "No cards selected."
+        }
+        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}
+

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}
+

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class RestoreIntegrityServiceTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testRejectsDuplicateCard() {
+        let base = validStateTemplate()
+        var mutated = base
+        let duplicateCard = mutated.waste.removeLast()
+        _ = mutated.stock.removeFirst()
+        mutated.stock.append(duplicateCard)
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(mutated)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsMissingRankInAValidSuit() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        state.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        state.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == illegalTop.suit && $0.rank == illegalTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == illegalBase.suit && $0.rank == illegalBase.rank)
+        }
+        state.foundations[.spades] = [
+            illegalBase,
+            illegalTop,
+        ]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+
+    private func validStateTemplate() -> GameState {
+        let ordered = DeckFactory.orderedCards()
+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
+
+        return GameState(
+            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
+            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
+            foundations: foundations,
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+    }
+
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
+            return "No cards selected."
+        }
+        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class RestoreIntegrityServiceTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testRejectsDuplicateCard() {
+        let base = validStateTemplate()
+        var mutated = base
+        let duplicateCard = mutated.waste.removeLast()
+        _ = mutated.stock.removeFirst()
+        mutated.stock.append(duplicateCard)
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(mutated)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsMissingRankInAValidSuit() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        state.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        state.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == illegalTop.suit && $0.rank == illegalTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == illegalBase.suit && $0.rank == illegalBase.rank)
+        }
+        state.foundations[.spades] = [
+            illegalBase,
+            illegalTop,
+        ]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+
+    private func validStateTemplate() -> GameState {
+        let ordered = DeckFactory.orderedCards()
+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
+
+        return GameState(
+            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
+            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
+            foundations: foundations,
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+    }
+
+}

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class UndoStackTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testUndoStackPushAndPopReturnExactPreviousState() {
+        var stack = UndoStack()
+        let stateOne = GameStateSnapshot(state: GameState(drawMode: .drawOne, terminalState: .active), capturedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1))
+        let stateTwo = GameStateSnapshot(state: GameState(drawMode: .drawThree, terminalState: .active), capturedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 2))
+
+        stack.push(stateOne)
+        stack.push(stateTwo)
+
+        let popped = stack.pop()
+        XCTAssertEqual(popped, stateTwo)
+    }
+
+    func [REDACTED:high_entropy]() {
+        var stack = UndoStack()
+        for index in 1...205 {
+            stack.push(GameStateSnapshot(state: GameState(), capturedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: Double(index))))
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(stack.entries.count, 200)
+        let oldestKept = stack.entries.first
+        XCTAssertEqual(oldestKept?.capturedAt, Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 6))
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum MoveValidator {
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let destinations = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        switch destinations.count {
+        case 0:
+            return .blocked(reason: reasonForEmptyDestination(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex))
+        case 1:
+            return .executed(Move(
+                cards: movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) ?? [],
+                source: source,
+                destination: destinations[0]
+            ))
+        default:
+            return .ambiguous(
+                source: source,
+                cardIndex: sourceIndex ?? 0,
+                destinations: destinations
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func attempt(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> MoveOutcome {
+        let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let cards else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        guard isLegal(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination, state: state) else {
+            return .blocked(reason: moveBlockedReason(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex, destination: destination))
+        }
+
+        return .executed(Move(cards: cards, source: source, destination: destination))
+    }
+
+    public static func legalDestinations(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [PileID] {
+        let movingCards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard let movingCards else { return [] }
+
+        let movingCard = movingCards[0]
+        var destinations: [PileID] = []
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let foundation = PileID.foundation(suit)
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: foundation, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(foundation)
+            }
+        }
+
+        for index in state.tableau.indices {
+            let tableau = PileID.tableau(index)
+            if tableau == source { continue }
+
+            if canMove(cards: movingCards, source: source, destination: tableau, state: state) {
+                destinations.append(tableau)
+            }
+        }
+
+        return destinations
+    }
+
+    public static func movingCards(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int? = nil
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        switch source {
+        case .stock:
+            return nil
+        case .waste:
+            guard let top = state.waste.last else { return nil }
+            return [top]
+        case .foundation:
+            return nil
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard let sourceIndex else {
+                return nil
+            }
+            return RunRelocation.maximalFaceUpRun(from: state, tableau: index, head: sourceIndex)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func isLegal(
+        cards: [Card],
+        source: PileID,
+        destination: PileID,
+        state: GameState
+    ) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return false }
+        let head = cards[0]
+
+        switch destination {
+        case .stock, .waste:
+            return false
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            if cards.count != 1 { return false }
+            return canPlaceOnFoundation(card: head, destination: state.foundations[suit] ?? [])
+        case .tableau(let destinationIndex):
+            if destination == source { return false }
+            let pile = state.tableau[destinationIndex]
+            return canPlaceOnTableau(card: head, destinationTop: pile.last)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnTableau(card: Card, destinationTop: Card?) -> Bool {
+        guard let destinationTop else {
+            return card.rank == .king
+        }
+        return destinationTop.suit.color != card.suit.color &&
+            destinationTop.rank.rawValue == card.rank.rawValue + 1
+    }
+
+    public static func canPlaceOnFoundation(card: Card, destination: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        if let top = destination.last {
+            return top.isFaceUp &&
+            top.suit == card.suit &&
+            top.rank.rawValue + 1 == card.rank.rawValue
+        }
+        return card.rank == .ace
+    }
+
+    public static func topCard(in state: GameState, pile: PileID) -> Card? {
+        switch pile {
+        case .stock:
+            return state.stock.last
+        case .waste:
+            return state.waste.last
+        case .foundation(let suit):
+            return state.foundations[suit]?.last
+        case .tableau(let index):
+            guard index >= 0, index < state.tableau.count else { return nil }
+            return state.tableau[index].last
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func reasonForEmptyDestination(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?
+    ) -> String {
+        guard movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) != nil else {
+            return "No legal move source selected."
+        }
+        return "No legal destination for selected card."
+    }
+
+    private static func moveBlockedReason(
+        in state: GameState,
+        source: PileID,
+        sourceIndex: Int?,
+        destination: PileID
+    ) -> String {
+        guard let cards = movingCards(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex) else {
+            return "Invalid source for move."
+        }
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else {
+            return "No cards selected."
+        }
+        let legal = legalDestinations(in: state, source: source, sourceIndex: sourceIndex)
+        guard legal.contains(destination) else {
+            return "Destination is not legal."
+        }
+        return "Move blocked."
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum RunRelocation {
+    public static func maximalFaceUpRun(
+        from state: GameState,
+        tableau tableauIndex: Int,
+        head cardIndex: Int
+    ) -> [Card]? {
+        guard tableauIndex >= 0, tableauIndex < state.tableau.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let pile = state.tableau[tableauIndex]
+        guard cardIndex >= 0, cardIndex < pile.count else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        let head = pile[cardIndex]
+        guard head.isFaceUp else {
+            return nil
+        }
+
+        var run = [head]
+        var cursor = cardIndex
+
+        while cursor + 1 < pile.count {
+            let next = pile[cursor + 1]
+            guard next.isFaceUp else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            let moving = run.last!
+            guard moving.rank.rawValue - 1 == next.rank.rawValue else {
+                break
+            }
+            guard moving.suit.color != next.suit.color else {
+                break
+            }
+
+            run.append(next)
+            cursor += 1
+        }
+
+        return run
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public struct UndoStack: Sendable {
+    private enum Constants {
+        static let maxDepth = 200
+    }
+
+    private(set) public var entries: [GameStateSnapshot]
+
+    public init(entries: [GameStateSnapshot] = []) {
+        self.entries = entries
+    }
+
+    public mutating func push(_ snapshot: GameStateSnapshot) {
+        entries.append(snapshot)
+        if entries.count > Constants.maxDepth {
+            entries.removeFirst(entries.count - Constants.maxDepth)
+        }
+    }
+
+    public mutating func pop() -> GameStateSnapshot? {
+        return entries.popLast()
+    }
+
+    public var isEmpty: Bool {
+        entries.isEmpty
+    }
+}

+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {

+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))

+        state.stock.removeAll {

+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }

+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {

+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)

@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+import Foundation
+
+/// Mandatory post-decode semantic validation (DEC-tech_specs-005): a
+/// successful Codable decode only proves the bytes round-tripped, not that
+/// the content describes a legal board. A failure here is routed through
+/// the existing dataLoss recovery path by the services_utilities lane, never
+/// silently activated as a resumed game.
+public struct DomainPersistenceRestoreIntegrityService {
+    public init() {}
+
+    public func validate(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
+        let allCardsResult = cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(state)
+        guard case .valid = allCardsResult else {
+            return allCardsResult
+        }
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let cards = state.foundations[suit] ?? []
+            if cards.isEmpty { continue }
+            if !MoveValidation.isLegalFoundationSetup(cards, suit: suit) {
+                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid foundation sequence for \(suit.rawValue).")
+            }
+            if !cards.allSatisfy({ $0.isFaceUp }) {
+                return .invalid(reason: "Foundation contains face-down card(s).")
+            }
+        }
+
+        for tableau in state.tableau {
+            if !isValidTableau(tableau) {
+                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid tableau stack order or illegal face-up transition.")
+            }
+        }
+
+        return .valid
+    }
+
+    private func cardsAreUniqueAndComplete(_ state: GameState) -> ValidationResult {
+        var allCards = state.stock + state.waste
+        for cards in state.tableau {
+            allCards += cards
+        }
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            allCards += state.foundations[suit] ?? []
+        }
+
+        if allCards.count != 52 {
+            return .invalid(reason: "Card count mismatch: expected 52, found \(allCards.count).")
+        }
+
+        var seen = Set<String>()
+        var rankBySuit: [Suit: Set<Int>] = [.clubs: [], .diamonds: [], .hearts: [], .spades: []]
+
+        for card in allCards {
+            if !seen.insert(card.id).inserted {
+                return .invalid(reason: "Duplicate card detected: \(card.suit.rawValue)-\(card.rank.rawValue).")
+            }
+            rankBySuit[card.suit, default: []].insert(card.rank.rawValue)
+        }
+
+        for suit in Suit.allCases {
+            let ranks = rankBySuit[suit] ?? []
+            if ranks.count != 13 {
+                return .invalid(reason: "Invalid card set for suit \(suit.rawValue).")
+            }
+            for rank in Rank.allCases {
+                if !ranks.contains(rank.rawValue) {
+                    return .invalid(reason: "Missing card \(rank.rawValue) of \(suit.rawValue).")
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        return .valid
+    }
+
+    private func isValidTableau(_ cards: [Card]) -> Bool {
+        guard !cards.isEmpty else { return true }
+
+        var hasFaceUpSegment = false
+
+        for index in 0..<cards.count {
+            let current = cards[index]
+
+            if current.isFaceUp {
+                if !hasFaceUpSegment {
+                    hasFaceUpSegment = true
+                    continue
+                }
+
+                let previous = cards[index - 1]
+                if !previous.isFaceUp { continue }
+
+                if previous.rank.rawValue - 1 != current.rank.rawValue {
+                    return false
+                }
+                if !MoveValidation.colorFlips(previous, current) {
+                    return false
+                }
+            } else if hasFaceUpSegment {
+                return false
+            }
+        }
+
+        return true
+    }
+}
+
