+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class RestoreIntegrityServiceTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testRejectsDuplicateCard() {
+        let base = validStateTemplate()
+        var mutated = base
+        let duplicateCard = mutated.waste.removeLast()
+        _ = mutated.stock.removeFirst()
+        mutated.stock.append(duplicateCard)
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(mutated)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected duplicate-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("duplicate"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsMissingRankInAValidSuit() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        state.stock.removeAll(where: { $0.suit == .hearts && $0.rank == .ace })
+        state.stock.append(Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .ace, isFaceUp: false))
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected missing-card board to be invalid.")
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("missing"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsIllegalTableauRun() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let badTop = Card(suit: .clubs, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        let badNext = Card(suit: .diamonds, rank: .five, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == badTop.suit && $0.rank == badTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == badNext.suit && $0.rank == badNext.rank)
+        }
+        state.tableau[0] = [badTop, badNext]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected illegal tableau transition to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("tableau"))
+    }
+
+    func testRejectsNonMonotonicFoundation() {
+        var state = validStateTemplate()
+        let illegalTop = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .two, isFaceUp: true)
+        let illegalBase = Card(suit: .spades, rank: .three, isFaceUp: true)
+        state.stock.removeAll {
+            ($0.suit == illegalTop.suit && $0.rank == illegalTop.rank) ||
+            ($0.suit == illegalBase.suit && $0.rank == illegalBase.rank)
+        }
+        state.foundations[.spades] = [
+            illegalBase,
+            illegalTop,
+        ]
+
+        let result = RestoreIntegrityService().validate(state)
+        guard case .invalid(let reason) = result else {
+            return XCTFail("Expected non-monotonic foundation to be invalid.")
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(reason.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("foundation"))
+    }
+
+    private func validStateTemplate() -> GameState {
+        let ordered = DeckFactory.orderedCards()
+        var foundations: [Suit: [Card]] = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: Suit.allCases.map { ($0, []) })
+
+        return GameState(
+            stock: Array(ordered.dropFirst(7)),
+            waste: Array(ordered.prefix(7)),
+            foundations: foundations,
+            tableau: Array(repeating: [], count: 7),
+            drawMode: .drawOne
+        )
+    }
+
+}

+import XCTest
+
+@testable import SolitaireAtelier
+
+final class UndoStackTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testUndoStackPushAndPopReturnExactPreviousState() {
+        var stack = UndoStack()
+        let stateOne = GameStateSnapshot(state: GameState(drawMode: .drawOne, terminalState: .active), capturedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1))
+        let stateTwo = GameStateSnapshot(state: GameState(drawMode: .drawThree, terminalState: .active), capturedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 2))
+
+        stack.push(stateOne)
+        stack.push(stateTwo)
+
+        let popped = stack.pop()
+        XCTAssertEqual(popped, stateTwo)
+    }
+
+    func [REDACTED:high_entropy]() {
+        var stack = UndoStack()
+        for index in 1...205 {
+            stack.push(GameStateSnapshot(state: GameState(), capturedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: Double(index))))
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertEqual(stack.entries.count, 200)
+        let oldestKept = stack.entries.first
+        XCTAssertEqual(oldestKept?.capturedAt, Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 6))
+    }
+}
